description: Top-scoring active confluences: tickers where several independent sources (politicians, 13F whales, Wall Street analysts, community and AI publishers) point the same way. Each item has score, side, horizon, actionability (go, caution, stop or past: how fresh the setup is and how far the price has moved from the sources' entry; a status label, not a recommendation), source mix, price_change_pct since detection (positive = moved in the confluence's favor) and a short narrative.
name: list_confluences
title: Signal confluences
